# The PWA Update (DeepNet v7)
This landmark release marks a major strategic pivot for Clash Manager. We are officially transitioning from legacy native application packaging (APK/Tauri) to a cutting-edge **PWA-First** architecture. This version resets the baseline to **v10.0.0**, powered by the new **Deep Net v7** intelligence core.

---
<br>

## Key Changes
### Changes Since v9.3.0
• Complete deprecation of native Android (APK) and Desktop (Tauri) configurations.
• Transition to a pure-web deployment model.

### Strategic Pivot: PWA & WebAPK
• **PWA-First Architecture**: Officially abandoned APK, TWA, and Tauri desktop systems in favor of high-performance web standards.
• **WebAPK Integration**: Optimized for professional Android delivery with 100/100 Lighthouse scores.
• **Asset Optimization**: Converted all manifest icons to **WebP format** to reduce fetch latency and improved PWA rendering stability by resolving legacy touch-event anomalies.
• **Native Experience**: Enhanced background sync, persistent notifications, and incremental badging for a native-like feel without the bloat.

### Deep Net v7 (Recruitment Engine)
• **Hybrid Benchmarking**: A new scoring standard that balances internal clan standards (40%) with the external talent market (60%).
• **Dynamic API Discovery**: Implemented a new automated discovery system for API keys, ensuring seamless connectivity to backend data sources with zero manual configuration.
• **Blueprint & Exhibition Modes**: Introduced specialized viewing modes for scouting—**Exhibition Mode** for high-level talent showcasing and **Blueprint Mode** for structural clan planning.
• **Structural Ceiling**: Enforced a strict 100% cap on potential scores for visual clarity and intuitive "Performance vs Standard" interpretation.

### Automation & Performance
• **Library Migration (Valibot)**: Replaced Zod with **Valibot** across the entire stack, resulting in a significant reduction in bundle size and faster schema validation.
• **Vite Chunking Strategy**: Optimized manual chunking and implemented aggressive lazy-loading for the validation layer, drastically improving First Contentful Paint (FCP).
• **Zero-Latency Sync**: Event-driven PR synchronization for seamless updates.
• **UX Feedback**: Added visible progress and success feedback for manual synchronization and force updates.

### Developer Experience & Infrastructure
• **Intelligent Merge Resolution**: Integrated new "Roo" modes to handle complex git merge conflicts automatically during high-velocity deployments.
• **Backend-Worker Integration**: Updated the core architecture to officially support and document the Backend-Worker ecosystem for distributed data processing.
• **Workflow Improvements**: Reworked internal systems for smoother debugging, including a reorganized hierarchy for project branches and consolidated client setup instructions.
